# Third-party component: aria2

AURA Download Manager is an Advertpreneur application. Its parallel download engine is the independent, open-source **aria2** project, created by Tatsuhiro Tsujikawa and contributors.

Source: https://github.com/aria2/aria2
Homepage: https://aria2.github.io/
License: GNU General Public License version 2 or later (see `COPYING`).

Windows AURA distribution packages the unmodified `aria2c.exe` executable from the Chocolatey aria2 package. Its separate license and upstream source remain available above. AURA's own UI is a separate application communicating with aria2 through localhost JSON-RPC. Please preserve this notice when redistributing the packaged binary.
